topic: 50th anniversary rally and memorial at Thammasat University organised by student councils, with calls for amnesty for young people charged under the royal insult law
scale: attendance not stated; numerous academics, activists and students at the Tha Phra Chan campus
quote1: Fifty years after a student demonstration against dictatorship ended in a massacre, Thailand's latest generation of protesters say they still face threats including prosecution, jail or exile.
quote2: Nearly 300 people have been charged under the so-called lese majeste law since 2020, including many young people who took part in large-scale protests that year to demand democratic change and reform of the monarchy.
